title: Post-review fix cycle for Story 1.5 lane A (record-append lock, payload_refs containment, reason code)
summary: One bounded fix cycle applying six reviewer-defined items to the kit's dispatch adapter: an exclusive lock around the story-record read-modify-write (a race the reviewer reproduced emptying the story file), worktree containment for payload_refs reusing the existing story-path rule, carrying the declared SIZING_REFUSED reason code on the refusal marker and log line, a doc example fix, a one-word doc-schema loop closure, and the post-review registry. Small surgical edits pinned by the reviewer's reproduction scripts; frozen launch command texts must stay byte-identical.
